name: Quandela
description: Quandela develops photonic quantum computers based on single-photon sources and manipulation. The company offers both on-premise quantum processors and cloud access to their quantum computing platform, targeting applications in optimization, simulation, and machine learning.

products.name: MosaiQ
products.description: Photonic quantum computing platform offering cloud access and on-premise deployment for optimization and simulation workloads

products.name: Single-Photon Sources
products.description: High-performance semiconductor single-photon emitters based on quantum dot technology for photonic quantum computing

highlights: One of Europe's leading photonic quantum computing companies with EUR 50M+ in funding
Offers both cloud-based and on-premise photonic quantum processors
Targets optimization, simulation, and machine learning applications

news.title: Quandela deploys Lucy photonic quantum computer integrated with Joliot-Curie HPC
news.excerpt: Franco-German consortium inaugurates the world's most powerful photonic quantum system alongside a European supercomputer for hybrid HPC-quantum workloads.

news.title: OVHcloud adds Quandela Belenos to its Quantum platform
news.excerpt: 12-qubit Belenos photonic quantum computer now available on OVHcloud's pay-as-you-go Quantum Platform for AI and simulation workloads.
